scope: Actual engine CTF spawn selection, common join-slot allocation, and ordinary player-sync serialization with controlled collision/delivery fixtures. Launcher and manager metadata checked with helper clients. This is not live CTF or mixed-client qualification.
server_change: Stop assigning advertised session capacity to the authored player/spawn count when a native GNS connection arrives.
Use a separate common free-slot allocator bounded by configured session capacity, authored records, and the engine array capacity; configured capacity already includes the dedicated host.
Preserve authored-count existing-player lookup, spawn selection, and SyncPlayers serialization.

checks: The actual selector reproduces the old fallback to start0 when a CTF lobby mask0xffff is combined with a truncated count8.

Red mask0xffffff00 selects0..7 and gold mask0xffff00ff selects8..15.
With host0 occupied, capacity8 admits only human slots1..7, rejects an eighth human despite unused authored records, and reuses only a free eligible slot.
A four-start map cannot allocate a fifth record even with configured capacity8; nonpositive capacity rejects admission.
Actual SyncPlayers serializes all32 records in its existing packet format while configured capacity remains8.
